《星落成诗》 / When Starlight Finds the Water
为「星海之间 · Starsea」重新创作的器乐配乐，2026 年 9 月。

原创旋律与编曲：Starsea / Codex
6/8 拍，降 E 大调，64 小节，钢琴、弦乐与竖琴。
音色来自以下独立乐器的单音录音，经过移调、包络、力度、声像、
乐谱编排、均衡及混响处理，离线渲染为完整音乐；未使用现成歌曲。

Piano / 钢琴
Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm.
Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Source: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano
Original collection: https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3
SFZ remapping: kinwie; retuned version: Markus Fiedler.
This recording uses selected soft/medium velocity samples, retuned, pitched,
sequenced and mixed for this original score. No endorsement is implied.

Strings and harp / 弦乐与竖琴
